\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}lim}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\widetilde{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\upsilon}}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}

\displaystyle\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}res}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\partial}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{u}}\big)_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}res}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\partial}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{u}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}

\displaystyle\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}res}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{u}}\big)_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}res}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{u}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}.

We then inductively define:

\displaystyle{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}lim}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\widetilde{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Upsilon}}}\big)

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}lim}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\widetilde{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Upsilon}}}

\displaystyle\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}lim}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\widetilde{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Upsilon}}}\big)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}

\displaystyle\equiv\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}lim}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\widetilde{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Upsilon}}}{{}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}d}}}}\big)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}

\displaystyle{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}lim}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\widetilde{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\upsilon}}}\big)

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}lim}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\widetilde{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\upsilon}}}

\displaystyle\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}lim}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\widetilde{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\upsilon}}}\big)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}

\displaystyle\equiv\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}lim}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\widetilde{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\upsilon}}}{{}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}d}}}}\big)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}

\displaystyle{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}res}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\partial}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{u}}\big)

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}res}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\partial}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{u}}

\displaystyle\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}res}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\partial}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{u}}\big)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}

\displaystyle\equiv\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}res}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\partial}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{u}}{{}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}d}}}}\big)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}

\displaystyle{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}res}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{u}}\big)

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}res}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{u}}

\displaystyle\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}res}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{u}}\big)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}

\displaystyle\equiv\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}res}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{u}}{{}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}d}}}}\big)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}.

As always, this says that the constructions are performed level-wise. From this, theorems
eqs.

4.25
,
4.26
,
4.27
and
4.28
then follow inductively, since the hypothesised display formulas were used to define each successive level. The correctness of these definitions will follow from verifying laws in
section

A.4
.

\triangleleft

4.2.9
The Simplicial Model

Having constructed the truncated simplicial models
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}
, we obtain the
simplicial model
fairly directly by taking a limit. In order to state this, we first define a
tail-cutting truncation functor
and extend
décalage
to an endofunctor:

\displaystyle{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}:\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}\to\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}}}

\displaystyle\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt}\right){{}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}D}}}}:\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}\to\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}

\displaystyle\left({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\right)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}

\displaystyle\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}{{}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}D}}}}\right)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}

\displaystyle\left({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\right)^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}b}\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}b}

\displaystyle\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}{{}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}D}}}}\right)^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}b}\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\mathbb{1}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}b}}

\displaystyle\left({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}\right)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}

\displaystyle\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}{{}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}D}}}}\right)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}

Since décalage is now an endofunctor,
{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\rho}
no longer involves truncation:

\displaystyle{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\rho}:\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt}\right){{}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}D}}}}\Rightarrow{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}}

\displaystyle\left({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\rho}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\right)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\mathbb{0}}{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{\langle}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{\rangle}}}}

Now we define the types and terms in
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}
to be compatible towers of types and terms in the truncated models
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}
.
In syntax this can be expressed by the following infinitary bidirectional rules:

\frac{\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}}{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}\right)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}\geq{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}2}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}2}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}2}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}2}}}}\quad({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}\left({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A})_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}\geq{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}2}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}2}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}2}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}2}}}}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}}\\
\frac{\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}}{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\right)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}\geq{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}2}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}2}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}2}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}2}}}}\quad({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}\left({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}\right)\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t})_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}\geq{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}2}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}2}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}2}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}2}}}}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}

We also define:

\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}\equiv\left({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}}\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}\equiv\left({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}\right)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}}.

The the above introduction rules equivalently then say that
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}
and
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}
in
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}
are defined by the data of each of the simplex levels
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}
and
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}
. At this point, every single construction in
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}
performed above extends to
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}
levelwise, since it is preserved strictly by all the finite truncation functors. In lieu of listing all of them, we will only give the case of
display
, which is slightly modified in the absence of truncation:

\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}+}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}{{}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}D}}}},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\rho}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}+}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}{{}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}d}}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}+}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}}\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}+}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}{{}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}D}}}}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}{{}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}d}}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}+}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}{{}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}d}}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}+}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\rho}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}}.

The computation rules for display on variables,
\Pi
-types, universes, and
\omega
-limits similarly hold in
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}
when modified to exclude
{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}
.

\triangleleft

4.3

M
odalities

We now relate the discrete (
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}
) and simplicial (
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}
) models by way of modalities, and introduce modal variants of the structural operations of a CwF.

The interesting facet of our approach is our treatment of
\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}\right)
and
\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\right)
. These examples concern the passage from
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}
to
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}
. Both examples construct a context in
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}
, but where (part of) the starting data is discrete —
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}
in the first example and
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}
in the second example. One naive approach to this construction would be to convert the discrete data to simplicial data (fibrantly so in the second case) — in the first example we would set values of the presheaf at
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}
to be zeros, and in the second example we would set the simplex types at levels
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}
to be units. However, this would require us to assume that the starting CwF has, respectively, an initial object and unit types. The approach that we take avoids these assumptions, and also ensures that all computation laws have definitionally strict interpretations.

4.3.1
Pieces of the triangle modality

We begin by dealing with
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}
.
The modality
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}
is supposed to construct a constant (augmented
semi-)
simplicial diagram, while its left adjoint
\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}
picks out the object of
({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}})
-simplices.
Both of these operations are determined levelwise by their behavior on truncated diagrams, which is where most of the work is.
Recalling that we will not be modeling the modality
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}
on
types
itself, since it would require assuming the existence of unit types in
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}
, in this section we describe the other aspects of
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}
in the models
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}
and how they fit together on

preserves all the operations defined above.
Therefore, we can define the untruncated operations
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}
and
\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}
on

and modal

\triangleleft

4.3.2
Pieces of the Box Modality

The box modality is more subtle because it is not determined levelwise by operations on truncated diagrams.
However, we can still construct it in terms of truncated data.
We start with a truncated lock functor
\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}}\right):\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}\to\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}}
that constructs a constant simplicial diagram:

\displaystyle\big({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}}\big)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}

\displaystyle\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}

\displaystyle\big({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}}\big)^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}b}

\displaystyle\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}

\displaystyle[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}}~]_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}

\displaystyle\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}.

We the define the following four new pieces of syntax.
The operation
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\scalebox{0.68}{$\square$}}\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}\right)}
is like a truncated version of
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}

\displaystyle{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\scalebox{0.82}{$\square$}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}

\displaystyle\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}~\big(\big({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\mathsf{zv}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}}_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}}\big)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\partial}\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}\right)}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\scalebox{0.82}{$\square$}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}\big)

\displaystyle{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\partial}\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}\right)}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}

\displaystyle\equiv\left({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}\right)_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\scalebox{0.68}{$\square$}}\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}\right)}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}

\displaystyle{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}

\displaystyle\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}.

We then define:

\displaystyle{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}lim}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}

\displaystyle{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}lim}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}.

We define the eliminator by:

\displaystyle{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}\left({{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\blacksquare}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{a}}\right)~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+1}}\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\mathsf{zv}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\pi}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}}_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}}~{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+1}}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\mathbb{0}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}}~[~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}res}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\partial}\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}\right)}~{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+1}}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\mathbb{0}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{a}},~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}res}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}~{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+1}}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\mathbb{0}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}n}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{a}}~].

One then checks the computation laws.

\triangleleft

4.3.3
The Extended Simplicial Model

So far, we have equipped the simplicial model
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}
with the locks
\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}
and
\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}
, modal extension and modal
\Pi
-types for
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}
, and a modality
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}
with Fitch-style introduction and elimination rules.
(Because
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}
satisfies an
\eta
-rule, we could then derive modal extension and modal
\Pi
-types for
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}
by simply extending and mapping out of
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}
, as we will do in
sections

4.3.6
and
4.3.7
for our eventual model.)

The modality
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}
presents a different problem: in syntax, for
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\;\mathsf{ob}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}
, the context
\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}\right)
is
flat
. This creates an issue of how we store such contexts semantically. Our solution is to extend the simplicial model constructed in
section

4.2
to what we call the
extended simplicial model
,
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}
, built out of a copy of
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}
(representing the flat contexts) and the original
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}
(representing the non-flat contexts).
We start with the non-modal aspects of this model.

4.3.3.1
Contexts and substitutions.

We have the following introduction rules:

\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\;\mathsf{ob}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}}{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\;\mathsf{ob}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}}\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\;\mathsf{ob}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}}{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\;\mathsf{ob}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}}\\
\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}\to_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}\to_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}\to_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}\to_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}\to_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}}{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}\to_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}

Equivalently, we can say that the underlying category of
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}
, which we denote
\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}
, is defined as follows:

\displaystyle\;\mathsf{ob}_{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}

\displaystyle\cong\;\mathsf{ob}_{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}}\sqcup\;\mathsf{ob}_{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}}

\displaystyle\mathsf{mor}_{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}~,~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\right)

\displaystyle\cong\mathsf{mor}_{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}}\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}~,~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\right)

\displaystyle\mathsf{mor}_{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}~,~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\right)

\displaystyle\cong\mathsf{mor}_{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}}\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}~,~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\right)

\displaystyle\mathsf{mor}_{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}~,~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\right)

\displaystyle\cong\mathsf{mor}_{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}}\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}~,~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}\right)

\displaystyle\mathsf{mor}_{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}~,~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\right)

\displaystyle\cong\emptyset.

This makes sense, because we intuitively think of
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}
as having been extended by zeroes, thus it is easy to map out of. A substitution of the form
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}
is known as
flat
.

\triangleleft

4.3.3.2
Types and Terms.

We have the following introduction forms for types and terms in
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}
:

\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}}\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}}\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}.

Formally, we set the following, depending on whether on not
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}
is flat:

\displaystyle\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Ty}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\right)

\displaystyle\cong\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Ty}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}

\displaystyle\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Tm}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\right)~\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)

\displaystyle\cong\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Tm}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}

\displaystyle\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Ty}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\right)

\displaystyle\cong\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Ty}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}

\displaystyle\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Tm}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\right)~\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)

\displaystyle\cong\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Tm}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}.

Note that, in the following definition of the functorial action of substitutions, the flat case discards higher data:

\displaystyle\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}}

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}

\displaystyle\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}\right)^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}}

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}

\displaystyle\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}}

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}

\displaystyle\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}\right)^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}}

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}

\displaystyle\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}}

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}}\right)^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}

\displaystyle\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}\right)^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}}

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}}\right)^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}.

Extension of contexts operates by passing under the inclusion:

\displaystyle\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)

\displaystyle\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)

\displaystyle[~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]

\displaystyle[~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]

\displaystyle[~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}~[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~].

Note that in the last case, if we have
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}\to\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}
then
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}\to{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}
. In order to form the extension
[~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}s}~]:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}\to\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\right)
, we must give
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\delta}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}s}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\delta}:\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\delta}
. We see then that such an
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}s}
has type
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}}\right)^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}
and must be of the form
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}
.

\triangleleft

4.3.3.3
\Pi
-Types and Universes.

We define (non-modal)
\Pi
-types and universes in
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}
by reducing to the respective constructs in
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}
and
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}
, depending on whether or not the context is flat:

\displaystyle{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Pi}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}~\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)~\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}B}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\left({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Pi}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}B}\right)

\displaystyle{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Pi}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}~\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)~\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}B}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~\left({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Pi}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}B}\right)

\displaystyle\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Type}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}

\displaystyle\equiv\begin{cases}\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Disc}}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}&\text{for}\quad\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\\
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Type}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}&\text{for}\quad\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}.\end{cases}

The definitions of
{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lambda}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}
,
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}app}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}
,
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Code}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}
, and
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}El}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}
are similar.

Note that stability under substitution is a more general property in
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}
since we have to additionally consider flat substitutions; if
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}\to\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}
, then we have:

\displaystyle\Big({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Pi}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}~\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)~\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}B}\right)\Big)^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}\;{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}}

\displaystyle\quad\equiv\Big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~\big({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Pi}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}B}\big)\Big)^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}\;{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}}

\displaystyle\quad\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\Big(\big({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Pi}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}B}\big)_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}\Big)^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}

\displaystyle\quad\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\Big({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Pi}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}B}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}\Big)^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}

\displaystyle\quad\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\Big({\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Pi}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}~\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}\right)^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}~\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}B}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}\right)^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}W}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}}\Big)

\displaystyle\quad\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Pi}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}~\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}\right)^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}\big)~\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}B}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}\right)^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}W}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}}\big)

\displaystyle\quad\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Pi}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}~\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\big)^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}\;{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}}~\big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}B}\big)^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}W}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}}\;\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}\;{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}\right)}

Similarly for universes:

\displaystyle\Big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Type}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}\Big)^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}\;{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}}

\displaystyle\equiv\Big(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Type}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}\Big)^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}\;{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}}

\displaystyle\quad\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\Big(\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Type}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}\right)_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}\Big)^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}

\displaystyle\quad\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Disc}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}

\displaystyle\quad\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Disc}}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}

\displaystyle\quad\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}Type}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}

What makes these calculations work is the relevant constructs have been defined to agree with their discrete counterparts in dimension
{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}
.
In the rest of this section, we show how
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}
and
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}
can be made into a model of all of dTT (except for the type-former
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}
).

\triangleleft

4.3.4
Locks and Keys

The definition of
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}
is tailored to allow us to define
\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}
.
Putting this together with the
\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}
and
\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}
defined on
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}
in
sections

4.3.1
and
4.3.2
, we now define a
{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}
-functor
\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}~\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt}~\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}:\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}M}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}coop}}}\to{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\mathcal{C}\!\mathit{at}}
, where
\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}M}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}coop}}}
denotes the
{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}
-category obtained by reversing both
{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}
and
{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}
cells. On modes, we have:

\displaystyle\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}~\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}\equiv\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}

\displaystyle\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}~\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}\equiv\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}.

To define this
{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}
-functor on modalities, we extend the prior definitions of locks to
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}
:

\displaystyle\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}\right)

\displaystyle\;:\;\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}\to\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}

\displaystyle\hskip 28.45274pt\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}\right)

\displaystyle\;:\;\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}\to\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}

\displaystyle\hskip 28.45274pt\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}\right)

\displaystyle\;:\;\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}\to\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}C}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\Delta^{+}}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}

\displaystyle\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}\right)

\displaystyle\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}\right)

\displaystyle\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}

\displaystyle\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}

\displaystyle[~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}~]

\displaystyle\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}

\displaystyle[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}~]_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}m}+{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}}

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}~]

\displaystyle[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}~]

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}.

\displaystyle[~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}~]

\displaystyle\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}

\displaystyle[~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}~]

\displaystyle\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}

We then define the evident composites:

\displaystyle\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\square}}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}\right)

\displaystyle\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\!\lozenge}}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}\right).

Finally, it is easy to check that
\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}\right)
and
\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}\right)
define identity functors. It follows that we have a contravariantly functorial assignment:

\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}p}\to{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}q}}{\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}~\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}\equiv\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}\right):\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}q}~\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}\to\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}p}~\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}}

Next, to define this
{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}
-functor on
{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}
-cells, we define the
key
natural transformations. We have
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}\leq{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}
,
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\square}}\leq{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}
, and
{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\leq{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\!\lozenge}}
, which corresponds to the following natural transformations:

\displaystyle\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}\leq{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}}:\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}\right)\Rightarrow\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}\right)

\displaystyle\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\square}}\leq{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}}:{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\Rightarrow\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\square}}\right)

\displaystyle\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\leq{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\!\lozenge}}}:\left(\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\!\lozenge}}\right)\Rightarrow{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}

\displaystyle\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}\leq{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}

\displaystyle\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\square}}\leq{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\square}}\leq{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}

\displaystyle\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}\leq{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\!\lozenge}}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}}

\displaystyle\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\square}}\leq{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{fl}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}

\displaystyle\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}\leq{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\!\lozenge}}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}.

We also have
\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\square}}\leq{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\!\lozenge}}}\equiv\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\square}}\leq{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}}\circ\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}\leq{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\!\lozenge}}}
. The keys assemble into a contravariantly functorial assignment:

\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\alpha}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}\leq{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\nu}}{\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\alpha}~\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}\equiv\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\alpha}:\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\nu}~\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}\Rightarrow\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}~\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}}.

One checks whiskering identities to verify that
\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}~\mathord{\hskip 1.0pt\text{--}\hskip 1.0pt}~\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.59721pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}
defines a
{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}2}
-functor
\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}M}}^{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}coop}}}\to{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\mathcal{C}\!\mathit{at}}
.

\triangleleft

4.3.5
Modal Types

Displayed Type Theory has two modal type formers that we need to model (recall that we omit
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}
at present):

\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}}\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}}.

These come with the following intro and elimination forms:

\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\blacklozenge}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}\\
\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\blacksquare}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~[~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\square}}\leq{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}~]}.

Note that there is an asymmetry between the statements of laws for
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\blacklozenge}}
and
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\blacksquare}}
. To clear up this confusion, we could have instead written:

\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\;\mathsf{flat}\quad{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\blacklozenge}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~[~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\!\lozenge}}\geq{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}~]}.

But this is
entirely equivalent
, because the semantic-side definition of the predicate
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\;\mathsf{flat}
is that
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}
is of the form
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}
, in which case we have
\left((\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}),~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}\right)\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}
by definition.
Note that the key
\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\!\lozenge}}\geq{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}
does not arise from a natural transformation and is only defined when
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}
, in which case we simply have
\text{\faIconFromMacro{faKey}}^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\!\lozenge}}\geq{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}}\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}1}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}
. The first definition can thus be seen as a proof-relevant pattern match along the
\mathsf{flat}
predicate.

The definition of
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}
and its introduction and elimination rules are done by shuffling around discrete information and inclusions:

\displaystyle{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}~\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}

\displaystyle{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}~\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}

\displaystyle{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\blacklozenge}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}.

For
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}
, we fall back to our prior construction for the type former and intro rule:

\displaystyle{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}~\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}

\displaystyle{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}~\left(\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}

For the eliminator, we split on whether or not
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}
is flat:

{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\blacksquare}}^{\;\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}\;{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}\equiv\begin{cases}\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\left({{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\blacksquare}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}\right)&\text{for}\quad\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\\
\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~\left({{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\blacksquare}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}\right)&\text{for}\quad\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\end{cases}

where the discrete case above is as follows:

\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\;\mathsf{ob}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}\quad{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}lim}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\vdash_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\blacksquare}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}}_{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}

It is defined by:

{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\blacksquare}}^{\;\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}\;{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}res}}^{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}{\mathchoice{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptstyle-$}1}{\scalebox{0.6}[1.0]{$\scriptscriptstyle-$}1}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathfrak{a}}

[formula]

4.3.6
Modal Variables

We have the following rules for extending a context and substitution modally:

\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}p}\to{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}q}\quad{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\;\mathsf{ob}_{\;{\small\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}q}{\small\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}}}\quad{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}\vdash_{\;{\small\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}p}{\small\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}}{\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\right)\;\mathsf{ob}_{\;{\small\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}q}{\small\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}}}}\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}\to_{{\small\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}q}{\small\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}\quad{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}\vdash_{\;{\small\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}p}{\small\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}}{[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Delta}\to_{{\small\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}q}{\small\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}}}\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\right)}

The case of
{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}
is defined as follows, splitting on whether or not
{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}
is flat:

\displaystyle\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\right)

\displaystyle[~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{dm}}}~[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]

\displaystyle\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\right)

\displaystyle[~\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}

\displaystyle\equiv\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}in_{sm}}}~[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]_{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}.

Following this, the rest of the definitions say that the case of modal extension reduces to extension by a variable or term of modal type:

\displaystyle\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\right)

\displaystyle[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}

\displaystyle\equiv[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]

\displaystyle\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\!\lozenge}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\right)

\displaystyle\equiv\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\lozenge}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\right)

\displaystyle[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\!\lozenge}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}

\displaystyle\equiv[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}

\displaystyle\big({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\big)

\displaystyle\equiv\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\right)

\displaystyle[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}

\displaystyle\equiv[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]

\displaystyle\big({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\square}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\big)

\displaystyle\equiv\left({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:^{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\square}}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\right)

\displaystyle[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle\!\square}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}

\displaystyle\equiv[~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\sigma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}t}~]_{{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\triangle}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}.

Each of the context extension operations comes with a notion of parent maps and variables:

\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}\vdash_{\;{\small\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}p}{\small\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}}{\mathsf{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}pt}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}:\big({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\big)\to{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma}}\frac{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}\vdash_{\;{\small\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}p}{\small\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}\;\mathsf{type}_{\;\!{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\ell}}}{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma}:{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\Gamma},~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}a}:^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}_{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}~{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\gamma},~\text{\faIconFromMacro{faLock}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}+}}_{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mu}\vdash_{\;{\small\mathopen{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{[}}}$}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}p}{\small\mathclose{\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}\kern-1.47914pt\hbox{${{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\boldsymbol{]}}}$}}}}{\color[rgb]{0,0.4,0}\mathsf{zv}}^{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}A}}_{{\color[rgb]{0,0,
